description.value: Harrison Hot Springs Resort is a landmark lakeside resort in Harrison Hot Springs, BC, built around five natural mineral pools averaging 1,300 parts per million of dissolved mineral solids — among the most concentrated in North America. The property includes a full-service spa, multiple restaurants ranging from a casual lakeside family restaurant to fine dining with nightly live entertainment, and wedding facilities. Touring cyclists arriving here encounter a classic BC resort destination on the shores of Harrison Lake with the coastal mountains as a backdrop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms an operating full-service resort with active packages dated into 2026. Multiple on-site dining venues (The Copper Room, Islands Patio & Lounge, Gardenia, Lakeside, Margaret's coffee kiosk) confirm nearby evening food. No mention anywhere on the website of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities, so those remain null. The phone number 604.796.2244 was found on the website's Getaway Package subpage but was absent from the OSM record.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists 604.796.2244 — added to listing from website source.
OSM community field lists 'Chilliwack' but Harrison Hot Springs Resort is located in the Village of Harrison Hot Springs, not the City of Chilliwack.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating full-service resort with active packages and confirmed on-site dining; a well-known destination for cyclists touring the Fraser Valley and Harrison Lake area.

Nearby evening food.detail: Multiple on-site evening dining venues confirmed: The Copper Room (dinner with nightly live entertainment), Islands Patio & Lounge (cocktails and casual menu), and Gardenia (sushi, cocktails, fine dining)
